title: 3 Simple Dance Moves for Beginners (Hip Hop Dance Moves Tutorial) | Mihran Kirakosian

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces three basic hip hop dance moves step by step, focusing on posture, weight distribution, and arm coordination. He breaks down each move using counts, demonstrates from different angles including side views, and finally connects all the moves together.
method.signature: The teacher emphasizes specific technical details like staying on the balls of your feet and maintaining bent knees to prevent stiffness.

practices.what: Demonstrates the first step with counts from 1 to 8, focusing on bending knees and adding flavor.
Introduces the second move, keeping the body in place while stepping out and in with one leg.
Connects move one and move two together and practices them continuously.
Teaches the third step involving a slide, demonstrating arm and leg coordination.
Connects all three steps together from start to finish without breaks between them.

adaptations.difficulty: Arms don't know what to do and become stiff
adaptations.adjustment: Clap your hands to keep the beat and keep your arms working until you feel comfortable

adaptations.difficulty: Knowing what to do with the upper body during the steps
adaptations.adjustment: Choose your own arm movements like clapping, pushing down, or using both hands

beliefs.belief: These three basic moves are perfect for beginners starting out in hip hop.
Learning takes repetition, and practicing steps over and over is necessary to overcome initial stiffness and lack of arm coordination.

moments.says: The teacher introduces himself, welcomes beginners to the tutorial, and explains they will be learning three basic hip hop moves.
The teacher addresses how beginners often become stiff and unsure what to do with their arms, suggesting clapping to keep the beat.
The teacher encourages the learner to keep practicing repeatedly until comfortable and invites them to leave comments for future moves.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable of mastering basic hip hop moves through steady practice and attention to rhythm and bounce.

struggles.theme: Feeling awkward or embarrassed practicing alone in a room
Watching from bed and never actually trying the moves
Moves look easy on video but feel difficult when trying in front of a mirror

clicked.theme: Clear step-by-step instruction and focus on weight distribution and staying on toes

requests.theme: Ask for a complete beginner playlist from easy to complex

meant.theme: Helped older beginners in their 40s and 50s start dancing for the first time
Gave confidence to people who thought they could never dance

method.limits: The video does not show interaction with live students or real-time feedback.
